dedupe_keys.name: census of agriculture profile for alberta

description: Two customised agriculture-census packages provide Alberta farm information. The Alberta profile covers 1991–2011 and explicitly includes greenhouse area in use, capital, operating arrangements and other land, crop, livestock and workforce measures. The 2011 land-use planning-region table explicitly includes irrigation, machinery, greenhouse, capital and operating-expense variables. These physical farm-system variables establish the infrastructure role; crop yields or biological inventories alone do not establish that role. Both packages list XLSX distributions. They form a bounded census family with distinct geographic and temporal coverage. Detailed irrigation equipment categories, greenhouse construction and machinery specifications are not stated. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
